keyword: ftc v invitation homes refund administrator

verifications.claim: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is mailing over 444,000 checks totaling more than $47.2 million to Invitation Homes renters.

verifications.claim: The mailing is due to a settlement over hidden fees and deceptive rental practices between January 2021 and September 2024.
